system_flow.title: Defaulter Tracking System Architecture
system_flow.description: This system tracks student defaulters in an educational institute, allowing different roles (Physical Education, Mentors, HODs) to manage data and generate reports. It's built with a React frontend, Node.js/Express.js backend, and MongoDB for data storage, including a separate email notification service.

nodes.label: Users (PE, Mentor, HOD)
nodes.description: Human users interacting with the system to input defaulter data, view reports, and manage student records based on their roles.

nodes.label: Frontend Web Application
nodes.description: The user interface built with React, providing login, data entry forms, and various report viewing and generation functionalities for different user roles.
nodes.technology: React.js, React Router, Axios, ExcelJS, File-Saver, XLSX

nodes.label: Backend API Server
nodes.description: A Node.js/Express.js application that handles user authentication, processes requests for adding and retrieving defaulter data, and orchestrates report generation and email notifications.
nodes.technology: Node.js, Express.js, CORS, Body-parser, MongoDB Driver

nodes.label: MongoDB Database
nodes.description: The NoSQL database storing all application data, including user accounts, student details, and records of latecomers and dress code violations.

nodes.label: Email Notification Service
nodes.description: A separate Node.js/Express.js service that sends automated email notifications based on requests from the Backend API, such as alerts about defaulters or reports.

edges.label: Interacts with UI
edges.description: Users access the web interface for various operations (login, data entry, report viewing).

edges.label: Sends API Requests
edges.description: The frontend sends HTTP requests for login, data submission, and report queries to the backend.

edges.label: Returns API Responses
edges.description: The backend processes requests and sends back data, authentication tokens, and status messages to the frontend.

edges.label: Performs CRUD Operations
edges.description: The backend reads user data, student records, and defaulter entries from, and writes new defaulter data to, the MongoDB database.

edges.label: Triggers Email Requests
edges.description: The backend sends requests to the Email Notification Service to initiate email sending for reports or alerts.
